scope: Source families/candidates/exclusions; not independent search engines or implemented providers. Official documentation and single-network probes, not an exhaustive global census or blanket commercial license.

definitions.A: Keyless public API/RSS/MCP or read subset; limits and per-content licensing still apply. Candidate entries require acceptance.
definitions.W: Public website/frontend/legacy feed; automated API availability is not established.
definitions.Q: Signup/key/identifier, free credits, or use-specific licensing conditions; not automatically enabled by this survey. Existing free mode still excludes keyed adapters.
definitions.R: Restricted/paid/approved access; excluded from unconditional free catalog.
definitions.S: Software or self-hosted tool, not a hosted source; out of current scope.
